name: Potion Promotion
source:
You've inherited your uncle's potion shop shortly after he has gone missing. It's your first day on the job- but that hasn't stopped the potion hungry customers from procuring their precious potions!

Will you choose the potions that support the people's wishes, or support the king's desires?

[From [url=https://mysmee.itch.io/potion-promotion]itch.io[/url]]
